newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa sells part of Paribas stake.
newsitem.headline: Axa sells part of Paribas stake.

text.p: French insurer Axa said on Friday that it sold on Thursday evening a block of three million shares in Paribas, representing 2.42 percent of the company's capital.
A spokesman told Reuter Axa sold the shares at 368.50 francs per share for a total price of 1.1 billion francs. Axa made a capital loss of about 100 million francs on the sale, the spokesman said.
The spokesman said that after the sale, it retained 9.76 percent of Paribas' capital and 15.77 percent of its voting rights.
The spokesman also said the sale was carried out with the approval of Paribas.
Paribas shares closed on Thursday at 378 francs, Axa shares ended the day at 359.20 francs on Thursday.
